list: the official 55 trophies, verified Nov 19 2026 against PlanetGTA6 (Nov 18, 2026), Exophase and PSNProfiles via PlanetGTA6
sources_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published on PSN (via Exophase / PSNProfiles, cross-checked on PlanetGTA6, Nov 18 2026). Unlock guidance is written in our own words from GTA Zone's full trophy guide (Nov 18, 2026), whose tips come from PowerPyx and GTABase. Five triggers are still unconfirmed by both PowerPyx and GTABase and are flagged honestly.

trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no extra task behind it: finish the story, work through the 100% checklist, then clean up the side activities, robberies and collectibles in this guide's roadmap order and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official list, Nov 18 2026
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in this guide.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and it unlocks when the mission ends. It is one of the first missions of the game, so this is normally the first trophy most players earn.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — story trophy, chapter 1
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it unlocks at the chapter's end. While you are still in Chapter 1, do the first meditation spot when it is offered at home — it is the one spot in the game that can become permanently unavailable later (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — story trophy, chapter 1
steps: Complete all Chapter 1 missions.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2 and it unlocks. Chapter 2 is also when Jason and Lucia become playable together, which opens up most of the side content — the last meditation spot, the Scooter Bros app from Moses, and Billy's jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub all start around here.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — story trophy, chapter 2
steps: Complete all Chapter 2 missions.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3 and it unlocks. By now Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs have handed you the Snap Gun, which is the tool Sneakthief wants for the jewelry store back door, so grab robbery trophies while you are in the area.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — story trophy, chapter 3
steps: Complete all Chapter 3 missions.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4 and it unlocks. An optional Chapter 4 mission opens the bank vaults, so once you have it, Maximum Withdrawal becomes available — bring a fast bike, because every vault job brings a 4-star wanted level.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — story trophy, chapter 4
steps: Complete all Chapter 4 missions.

trophies.guide: Gold story trophy. Finish the final mission and it unlocks. Keep a manual save from just before the final mission: there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so a save is your only way back to any story content. After the credits the whole map stays open in free roam for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — story trophy, final mission
steps: Complete the final mission.
Save manually before it — there is no mission replay.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run and it unlocks. Like all story trophies it cannot be missed — just play the mission through.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — story trophy, chapter 2 mission
steps: Complete the mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist and it unlocks. It is a story beat, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — story trophy, chapter 3 mission
steps: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play and it unlocks. Story trophies cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — story trophy, chapter 4 mission
steps: Complete the mission Child's Play.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners and it unlocks. Story trophies cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — story trophy, chapter 4 mission
steps: Complete the mission Headliners.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown and it unlocks. The airport comes back later for Catch Me If You Can, so remember the layout.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — story trophy, chapter 4 mission
steps: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory and it unlocks. Story trophies cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — story trophy, chapter 5 mission
steps: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: Gold, and the hardest trophy on the list. Open the 100% Completion checklist under Progress, then Stats — it appears after the story, but progress made earlier still counts, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx notes the checklist is really about 60% true completion: 300 of 397 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone races, 70 of 80 challenges, 100 WAiNK locations, 3 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, all 8 vaults, all 39 gang operations and 15 of 18 meditation spots. See the Roadmap view for the full table.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 100% checklist, figures from PowerPyx
steps: Finish the story first — the checklist appears under Progress, then Stats.
Work the Roadmap view's 100% Completion table line by line.

trophies.guide: Silver. Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered across Leonida — jumps, near misses and the like all count toward the same total. The trophy only needs 250, but 100% Completion wants 300, so keep going past the pop if you are chasing the platinum.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 250 of 397 stunts; 300 for 100%
steps: Complete any 250 stunts (300 for 100% Completion).

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, racing, shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the gym, for example. One go at each is enough; you do not need to win or finish anything, just sample them all.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — activity list, tips from PowerPyx
steps: Try all 9 activity types once.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver. Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Work range by range and learn each challenge's par time and target layout; gold is a score bar, not a single perfect run, so steady accuracy beats rushing.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 42 golds across 12 ranges
steps: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per spot is enough for the trophy. If you are chasing 100% Completion, you will need all 42 races eventually, so winning every race at a spot while you are there saves a return trip.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 14 spots; all 42 races for 100%
steps: Win one drone race at each of the 14 locations (all 42 races for 100%).

trophies.guide: Bronze. Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Winning the same race twice does not count, so spread your wins across the list and tick them off as you go.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 20 of 40 races; repeats do not count
steps: Win 20 different races (out of 40).

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. He texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon, so follow the message rather than hunting for him. Any fishing challenge against him counts.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — Cal texts after a Chapter 1 mission, purple icon
steps: Wait for Cal's text after a Chapter 1 mission, then beat him in a fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: Bronze. Finish a single arcade game all the way through. Pick the shortest one you can find and see it to its end screen — starting one is not enough.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — complete one arcade game
steps: Complete one arcade game from start to finish.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Finish Andy's mission strand and complete his final mission. Andy's jobs are side content, not story, so work through them when they appear; they stay available in free roam after the story if you leave them late.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — final mission for Andy
steps: Play Andy's missions through to his final one.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Finish Kenton's mission strand and complete his final mission. Like the other character strands it stays open after the story, so it can be done during cleanup if you prefer.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — final mission for Kenton
steps: Play Kenton's missions through to his final one.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Finish Billy's mission strand and complete his final mission. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and they stay open after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — Billy's five jobs, Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kelly County
steps: Start Billy's jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission.
Play through to his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete 8 mission strands for strangers — but only some strangers count. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not, so do not waste time counting those. Work the four counting strands plus any other qualifying ones until the total hits 8.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — counting: Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete
steps: Complete 8 qualifying stranger strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Finish Randy's mission strand and complete his final mission. It stays open after the story if you leave it for cleanup.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — final mission for Randy
steps: Play Randy's missions through to his final one.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Finish Tyrone's mission strand and complete his final mission. Note that Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so treat it as its own trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — final mission for Tyrone; does not count for Strangers & Freaks
steps: Play Tyrone's missions through to his final one.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Bronze, and the only trophy in the game that may be missable. Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. The first spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter — nobody has confirmed whether the trophy needs it, but PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it to be safe. The last meditation needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Note that 100% Completion only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so this trophy's risk does not threaten A Long Road. See the Missable Watch view for the full save strategy.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 18 spots, 10 locations; missable warning from PowerPyx
steps: Meditate at the Chapter 1 home spot before Chapter 1 ends.
Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida (15 for 100%).

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only. Honest flag: the exact animal has not been confirmed yet by PowerPyx or GTABase as of Nov 18, 2026, so do not trust any list that names one — start Bret's quests after Chapter 2 and follow his own instructions in game.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — Bret's quests after Chapter 2, Jason-only; animal unconfirmed
steps: Start Bret's hunting quests after Chapter 2 (Jason-only).
Follow Bret's in-game instructions for the unique animal.
trophies.unconfirmed: exact animal not yet confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase (Nov 18, 2026)

trophies.guide: Silver. Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect as you travel and trade duplicates where you can; you only need 3 finished sets, not all 18.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 3 of 18 sets
steps: Complete any 3 collectible card sets (out of 18).

trophies.guide: Silver. Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — any mix of Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. The camera tool is the fastest way to tick off the map while you travel, so WAiNK everything you pass.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 100 locations; Landmarks 31, Curiosities 35, Sculptures 23
steps: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida.

trophies.guide: Bronze. Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. They cover the game's systems — driving, combat, exploration and more — so most of them happen naturally while you play. The trophy needs 50, but 100% Completion wants 70, so keep the counter in mind.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 50 of 80 challenges; 70 for 100%
steps: Complete any 50 challenges (70 for 100% Completion).

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Bronze. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Break line of sight, get out of the search area and stay hidden until the stars clear — a fast car and a quiet corner of the map do the job.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 4-star wanted level with partner, escape
steps: With your partner, reach a 4-star wanted level.
Lose the heat and escape.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bronze. With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without losing your wanted level between them — the trick is keeping the heat alive, not losing it. Plan a route with three close shops, hit them in sequence, and do not let the stars drop to zero before the third.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 3 shops back-to-back with partner, keep the wanted level
steps: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level.

trophies.guide: Bronze. Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them. Scan every new vehicle you pass and the total climbs fast. The trophy needs 100, but 100% Completion wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning everything.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 100 discovered; 200 of 277 for 100%
steps: Scan and discover 100 vehicles (200 of 277 for 100%).

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Fill your Combat Focus first, then take down 5 enemies in one use of it. An assault rifle helps: find a spot with a group of enemies, trigger Focus, and sweep through five before it runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 5 enemies in one Combat Focus; assault rifle advised
steps: Fill Combat Focus, then down 5 enemies in a single use.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Bronze. At Vice City International Airport, steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate, take off and get about 1 km away. Expect attention on the runway — get airborne quickly and put distance between you and the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — steal a jet at a boarding gate, fly about 1 km away
steps: Steal a passenger jet parked at a VCIA boarding gate.
Take off and fly about 1 km away.

trophies.guide: Bronze. Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The base is guarded, so go in ready for a fight, grab a Rhino and use its cannon on the enemies around you.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station
steps: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station.
Take out enemies from inside it.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you the Snap Gun for the back door — use it to get in quietly, take the goods and leave without tripping an alarm or a witness.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — Snap Gun from Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs, back door
steps: Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs.
Rob a jewelry store through the back door, unseen.

trophies.guide: Silver. Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission, and every vault job always brings a 4-star wanted level, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway. You only need 5, but 100% Completion wants all 8.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 5 of 8 vaults; 4 stars every time; fast bike advised
steps: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape (all 8 for 100%).

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Rob an armored truck and escape. A bank vault job also counts if you get away, so this often pops while you are working on Maximum Withdrawal anyway.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — armored truck; a vault escape counts too
steps: Rob an armored truck and escape (a vault escape also counts).

trophies.guide: Bronze. Explore every area of Leonida until the map's fog is fully cleared. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the map — fly over each region until nothing is left in shadow.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — clear the fog from the whole map; a plane is fastest
steps: Clear the fog from the entire map of Leonida.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. You only need one per gang for the trophy, but 100% Completion wants all 39 operations, so note which gangs you have done as you go.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — one per gang, 9 gangs; all 39 for 100%
steps: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs (all 39 for 100%).

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Bronze. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Honest flag: the exact trigger has not been confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase as of Nov 18, 2026. The best reading of the description is to find a bar or spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail and enjoy it — but treat that as a lead, not a solved step, until players crack it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — exact trigger unconfirmed
steps: Head to Ocean Beach and look for a cocktail spot with a view.
trophies.unconfirmed: exact trigger not yet confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase (Nov 18, 2026)

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Bronze. The description points to smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Honest flag: the exact trigger has not been confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase as of Nov 18, 2026. The leading reading is to drive a car out through the showroom window — try it in a showroom, but treat it as unconfirmed until players crack it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — unconfirmed; description points to the showroom window
steps: Try driving out through a vehicle showroom window.
trophies.unconfirmed: exact trigger not yet confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase (Nov 18, 2026)

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police. The operation is the trigger, not a game of bowling — hit the gang's operation at the alley and escape the heat afterwards.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — rob the Kingpin Bowling operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police
steps: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn.
Lose the police.

trophies.guide: Bronze. Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia — working out together trains both at once, so take them to the gym as a pair and build their Strength to the top.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — max Strength for both; working out together trains both
steps: Work out with Jason and Lucia together until both reach max Strength.

trophies.guide: Bronze. Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the running count of the choices you make across the game. Play normally and it climbs on its own. One warning from GTA Zone: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile, because it is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 500 profile actions; Irredeemable is permanent
steps: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile.
Avoid pushing toward the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent.

trophies.guide: Bronze. The description hints at succeeding on a second try. Honest flag: the exact trigger has not been confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase as of Nov 18, 2026. The best reading is that something in the game wants a retry — a failed attempt followed by a success — but nobody has pinned down which one yet, so treat any specific claim as unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — exact trigger unconfirmed
steps: No confirmed steps yet — the trigger is still being cracked.
trophies.unconfirmed: exact trigger not yet confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase (Nov 18, 2026)

trophies.guide: Bronze. The description suggests witnessing something strange. Honest flag: the exact trigger has not been confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase as of Nov 18, 2026. It is most likely a random world event or encounter — keep playing and exploring, and do not trust any guide that claims a solved step yet.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — exact trigger unconfirmed
steps: No confirmed steps yet — the trigger is still being cracked.
trophies.unconfirmed: exact trigger not yet confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase (Nov 18, 2026)

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bronze. The description points to a melee drive-by — knocking someone over from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Honest flag: the exact trigger has not been confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase as of Nov 18, 2026. The leading reading is a melee strike from a moving vehicle, but treat it as unconfirmed until players crack it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — exact trigger unconfirmed
steps: Try a melee strike from a moving vehicle.
trophies.unconfirmed: exact trigger not yet confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase (Nov 18, 2026)

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — it is a running total, so every laundered dollar counts. Yasmani pays the most, so route your bills through him when you can.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — $250,000 running total; Yasmani pays most
steps: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts (Yasmani pays most).

trophies.guide: Bronze. Spend $100,000 across all shops as a running total. Normal shopping while you play covers much of it; the rest is a good excuse to buy the gear, clothes and upgrades you have been eyeing.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — $100,000 running total across shops
steps: Spend $100,000 across all shops.

trophies.guide: Bronze. Buy all 8 garage properties for sale — about $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count, so only the 8 purchasable ones matter. Save up during the money trophies and buy them in one sweep.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — 8 for sale, about $160,000; story garages do not count
steps: Purchase all 8 garage properties for sale.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Bronze. Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2. You need free garage space for each registration, so keep a slot open and register vehicles as you discover them.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: GTA Zone, Nov 18 2026 — Scooter Bros app from Moses in Chapter 2; free garage space needed
steps: Get the Scooter Bros app from Moses in Chapter 2.
Register 10 vehicles (keep free garage space).
